translation.name: No Sigar Kunubus tika ma Ira Ninge na Lotu

content: Devit ga pit iakan ra ninge.

content.text: Tano Watong no pise ma ira linge bakut tana.
No ula hanuo mah ma diet ing diet la lon aram naliu tana auno.
Kanong warah, no Watong at ga hakisi no ula hanuo narako ta ira tes,
ma ga hatur mah ie naliu ta ira taah.
Sige na kawas no uladih tano Watong?
Ma si mah na tur narako tano uno halhaliana subaan?
Aie nong ira iruo lumana pai bilinge ma no kaatine i gamgamatien,
pa na lotu tupas ira palimpuo,
ma pa na sasalim ma ira linge pai tutun.
Na kap no haraidaan meram tano Watong,
ma God, no uno Ut na Harhalon, na haminas bia a takodasiana ie.
Ira mangana matanaiabar hokaiken, kaike ra tunotuno ing diet silsilihe mur ie.
Diet la silsilihe no num matmataan, God ta Iakop.
Muat ira matanangaas, tapapos!
Muat ira matanangaas menalua saakit, tamapapos,
waing no King nong a tamat no minarine na me haan laka.
Sige iakan ra King nong i tamat no minarine?
No Watong nong a dadasinei ma ana tamat na baso,
no Watong nong ana mon tamat na dadas wara hinarubu.
Muat ira matanangaas, tapapos!
Muat ira matanangaas menalua saakit, tamapapos,
waing no King nong i tamat no minarine na me haan laka.
Ma sige ie, iakano King nong i tamat no minarine?
No Watong Nong i Dadas Harsakit.
Aie no King nong i tamat no minarine.
